title: World's End Pub
desc: The Worlds End Pub is a British pub which has a relaxed atmosphere to it. There are events daily and cash prize bingo each week.

title: The Blarney Stone
desc: The Blarney Stone Irish Pub offers a vibrant atmosphere with daily social events and live DJ music. Visitors can also enjoy live music concerts making it a lively hub for entertainment and community gatherings. Learn more about their events at dublinsl.net

title: Rug's Boom Boom Blue
desc: Rugs BoomBoomBlue is a seedy blues bar and Burlesque-styled dive in Second Life.  Join the bar flies and rats for a chat, or come answer trivia in the beautiful gardens while dancing with a friend.

title: Wine Cellar Bistro
desc: Wic Foods presents a pay as you dine casual yet classic dining restaurant with beautiful music for sharing your time with friends and family. Let your busy day fade away. This destination is child friendly and is open for self-serve 24/7. Cafe roleplay service available with reservation.

title: Umami Groove
desc: Umami Groove is a listening bar and sushi restaurant serving not only great consumable sushi but also the finest selections of downbeat, nu jazz, trip hop, and other audiophile gems.

title: Yu Hua Restaurant and Bar
desc: Yu Hua Restaurant and Bar is a cozy community hangout offering a restaurant, maid café, and coffee bar. Visitors can enjoy regular live events, relax with friends, and find a welcoming space for newcomers to connect and socialize.

title: Eagles Nest
desc: Welcome to Eagles Nest, a bar, games room, lounge, and cafe where you can enjoy live music or just hang around with your friends. Play one of the raging popular games like; Cheesy, Greedy, Skippo, Hand and Foot, Pentadee, U-Know, and many more. Come and enjoy!

title: The Booze and Boos Haunted Pub
desc: Discover The Booze and Boos Pub! One of the most haunted places in Second Life, where the spirits aren’t just inside the bottles. Expect real ghosts, good company, and some very weird noises! Come for the atmosphere, stay because the door slammed shut on its own.

title: Scarpone's Cigar Bar and Lounge
desc: Welcome to Scarpone's Cigar Bar and Lounge, your premier destination for R&B, Hip-Hop, Southern Soul, Neo Soul, Old School, and Reggae vibes paired with the finest cigars and handcrafted drinks. There are three locations to choose from, all great for a date night. They also do parties and events.

title: The Grey Hound Irish Pub
desc: The Grey Hound pub has been carefully crafted and designed to evoke the Irish countryside and coast, tucked away within Second Life. Grab a pint, invite friends, turn on the stream, relax, and transport yourself to a rainy afternoon in the Irish coast.

title: Bear Lake Mountain Resort
desc: Bear Lake Mountain Resort, located on BearClawMountain, offers elegant dining at the Ristorante Armastus Continental Cuisine, Benny's Bar, DJ events, pool, games, and a Hotel. All with a beautiful mountain view.

title: The Restaurant at the End of the Universe
desc: In the beginning, the Universe was created. This made many people very angry and has been widely regarded as a bad move. Visit this cosmic delight, the last restaurant in the Universe!

title: Dylan's On The Bay
desc: Dylan's On The Bay is where elegance meets the open water. Located in the heart of the Blake Sea, it’s the perfect place to watch the sunset, chat with friends, and listen to music. Dylan’s is a bar open 24/7 with live music on Saturday nights. A popular stop for boaters and yachtsmen, it offers 2-hour courtesy dock space and public anchorage in a tropical nautical setting.

title: 1997 Bar & Lounge - Morgantown
desc: 1997 Bar & Lounge is located on the northern tip of Heterocera nestled in vibrant Morgantown. They offer a large variety of beverages, space, and 2 private rooms for couples out on a romantic night out.

title: Chateau Noir At Harmony
desc: Chateau Noir is an upscale fine dining restaurant in Harmony Hills, offering a live service interactive role-play dining experience. Whether you're seeking romance, a social gathering, or a family feast, Chateau Noir caters to all occasions.

title: The Sleeping Golem Pub & Grill
desc: The Sleeping Golem Pub is a smoky dive bar with a chill atmosphere.  Relax and chat in a dim and lived-in space with lots of games and an open stage. All are welcome!

title: Key 9 Fine Dining Experience
desc: The Key 9 Fine Dining Experience is a delightful breath of fresh air. All the champagne you desire with small bites and lovely water fountains with guardians to guide your way through the garden. Visit with a friend or come on your own to join the fun!

title: The Burnt Toast Tavern
desc: Welcome to The Burnt Toast Tavern, a traditional British pub with a friendly welcome and the only sassy AI barmaid in SL! Come have a beer and enjoy the banter that only their barmaid can deliver! Choose your favourite tunes from the working jukebox and dance with friends, old and new! Enjoy a glass of wine on the terrace and watch the sunset or explore the beautiful surroundings. All are welcome!

title: Baking Bunny Tea Room
desc: Nestled in the heart of Mieville’s Kipling Steampunk shopping district, the Baking Bunny Tea Room provides treats to go and a full-service menu. It’s the ideal place for avatars of diverse morphics to chat and relax in genteel Victorian surroundings and enjoy a spot of tea or meal together.

title: The Forum Cartel Hangout
desc: Chat and make friends at The Forum Cartel Hangout, one of the longest-running communities in Second Life. In addition to the pub, you'll find a nearby sandbox, photo studio and freebies.

title: KOI
desc: KOI is an elegant dining destination nestled within Shangri-La SL International Hotel & Resort in Second Life. KOI blends sophisticated surroundings with an intimate dining experience created for memorable evenings. From romantic date nights and quiet dinners for two to celebrations and gatherings with friends, KOI offers the perfect setting to unwind.

title: Thistle by the Sea
desc: Nestled along a windswept coast, Thistle by the Sea is a cozy seaside escape where salt air and simple comforts invite you to slow down. Visit the Wooly Thistle Pub, enjoy something sweet from The Salted Scoop Ice Cream Shoppe, or stop by The Green Shutter Inn. With cozy spots to relax, games to enjoy, and a waterfront boat rez zone, there's something here for both quiet moments and gentle adventure. Thistle by the Sea, where salt air, small comforts, and coastal charm meet.

title: Karen's Fast Food Restaurant and Motel
desc: Enjoy a quick meal with friends, at Karen's Fast Food Restaurant, or spend the night at the motel and have a pool party!

title: Greg's Bar & Lounge at Woodland
desc: Visit this modern luxury destination surrounded by nature! Jump off the Sky Bar while enjoying the view of the mainland, enjoy the pool, take a ride on the bar train, or just sit back and relax!

title: Sirenz Traditional English Pub
desc: Sirenz Traditional English Pub is a welcoming roadside pub on Route 8A, offering a traditional English atmosphere, beer garden, dancing, playable pool tables, and a relaxed place to meet friends or unwind. Free parking is available, so stop by for a drink, stay for the company, and grab some free fish and chips for the journey home.

title: The Flamingo Club
desc: Welcome to The Flamingo Club, where vintage glamour meets after-dark decadence. Step inside a world of golden lights, seductive music, cocktails, dancing, and unforgettable nights. Inspired by classic supper clubs, smoky jazz lounges, New Orleans nightlife, and a touch of retro excess, The Flamingo Club is a place to dress up, loosen up, and stay a little too late.

title: Pinstripes Fine Dining
desc: Experience elegant dining and romantic ambiance at Pinstripes Fine Dining. It's perfect for date nights, weddings, parties, and roleplay events. Enjoy gourmet meals and a timeless atmosphere in a beautifully designed restaurant setting. It is fully MyStory compatible with a full menu and a kids' menu for family time. Free self-serve or reserve a full roleplay experience with one of their servers.

title: Whiskey Road
desc: Whiskey Road is a live music bar where the stage is set, the drinks are poured, and the music takes center stage. Immerse yourself in an authentic live music experience.

title: The Forest Room
desc: The Forest Room is another chef's house location designed by Jennifer Steele. Eat in an elegant atmosphere by the ocean or choose take-out. You will find dancing, food, and live entertainment. It is also Xeolife/MyStory compatible and Zooby friendly.

title: Ristorante Kandela
desc: Ristorante Kandela is a free and self service restaurant on the Kultivate region! This venue is decorated in an Italian rustic style and features crooner music and couples intan so you can enjoy a romantic date out with your loved one. The restaurant is also available for private events, free of charge. For more info, visit: kultivatemagazine.com/ristorante-kandela

title: O'Hare's Gap
desc: Get swept away by the quaint, charming atmosphere of this rural Irish village, set in 1939. Stop by and say hello to the locals at Malone's Pub, or visit the Blarney Castle. Don't forget to enhance your luck by kissing the fabled Blarney Stone!

title: Die Betrunken Maus (The Drunken Mouse)
desc: Die Betrunken Maus is the crown jewel of the Bellisseria Chalet regions. Virtual beer is on tap 24/7 and last call is at never o'clock. Set in the peaks along a winding river, this alpine-style inn serves the public for meetups and socializing.
